observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== glob in transformed app.ts (which pages registered) ==="; curl -s "http://localhost:5173/resources/js/app.ts" | grep -oE "import\(.*/pages/[^)]+\.vue" | head; echo; echo "=== Confirm NavUser/AppHeader transform (should be broken) ==="; for f in NavUser AppHeader; do echo "-- $f --"; curl -s "http://localhost:5173/resources/js/components/$f.vue" | grep -oE "\"message\":\"[^\"]+\"" | head -1; done; echo; echo "=== Confirm MainPage + its comps transform OK (200 & no Error) ==="; for f in "pages/MainPage" "components/Navigation" "components/Sensor" "components/Ochsi" "components/HomeInfoCard" "components/InfoCard" "components/SensorCard"; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/r.txt -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:5173/resources/js/$f.vue"); err=$(grep -c "Failed to resolve" /tmp/r.txt); echo "$f -> HTTP $code, resolve-errors=$err"; done
